CustomField.description: True if a closed case took longer than its SLA hours, or an open case is past SLA Due. Used for the SLA breach % report.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Calculated: did this case miss its deadline?
CustomField.label: SLA Breached
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(SLA_Due__c), FALSE, IF(IsClosed, Resolution_Hours__c > Service_Category__r.SLA_Hours__c, NOW() > SLA_Due__c))
